title: Pluralistic Alignment for Healthcare: A Role-Driven Framework
findings: The proposed ETHOSAGENTS framework effectively generates pluralistic responses that can represent faith-based perspectives on healthcare issues as one of several valid viewpoints. The framework uses dynamically generated personas, such as a 'Religious Moralist', to capture these specific stances without requiring specialized fine-tuning, outperforming baselines in representing a diversity of values.

measurement_description: The paper evaluates models on their ability to represent diverse perspectives in healthcare scenarios, including faith-based viewpoints on medical interventions like vaccination. For example, it measures whether a model can generate a response reflecting that 'Some faith traditions discourage medical interventions like vaccines, viewing them as interference with divine will'.
